elements.label: Figure 1.2
elements.description:
Grouped vertical bar chart titled "Issues of greatest concern, 2015–2020". Y-axis: "Percent of respondents", scale 0 to 30 in steps of 5. X-axis: years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020. Legend (series): Poverty/Hunger (teal), Economic Growth/GDP (orange), Environment (grey), Health/Insurance (yellow). No values are printed on the bars; approximate readings are:
- 2015: Poverty/Hunger ~18; Economic Growth/GDP ~4.5; Environment ~2; Health/Insurance ~2.4
- 2016: Poverty/Hunger ~24.5; Economic Growth/GDP ~7; Environment ~12.5; Health/Insurance ~0.8
- 2017: Poverty/Hunger ~28.5; Economic Growth/GDP ~7.8; Environment ~7.4; Health/Insurance ~1.4
- 2018: Poverty/Hunger ~25; Economic Growth/GDP ~9; Environment ~6.6; Health/Insurance ~1.1
- 2019: Poverty/Hunger ~24.8; Economic Growth/GDP ~11; Environment ~8.9; Health/Insurance ~1.6
- 2020: Poverty/Hunger ~17.8; Economic Growth/GDP ~13; Environment ~3.9; Health/Insurance ~15.5
Source line below the chart: "Source: CECODES, VFF-CRT, RTA & UNDP (2021)." Poverty/Hunger is the largest concern in 2015–2019 and peaks in 2017; in 2020 Health/Insurance and Economic Growth/GDP rise sharply while Poverty/Hunger and Environment fall.
